_README: Projects manifest. Each item appears as a card on /work.html. Add a new entry here, drop a case-study HTML at /projects/<slug>.html, and the card renders automatically.
_HOW_TO_ADD: 1) Add a new entry to items[] below.
2) Create /projects/<slug>.html (copy an existing one as a template).
3) Put screenshots in /images/ and reference them.

_FIELDS.slug: URL slug, used for /projects/<slug>.html and as the data-cat
_FIELDS.title: Display title
_FIELDS.subtitle: One-line pitch under the title
_FIELDS.image: Hero image path (used as card thumbnail)
_FIELDS.stack: Array of {name, level} where level is 1-3 (proficiency dots)
_FIELDS.metrics: Array of {value, label} — 3-4 entries shown as inline badges
_FIELDS.demo: Optional URL to live demo (omit if private/none)
_FIELDS.demoCreds: Optional 'demo / demo' string shown next to demo link

items.title: RxFY — Antibiotic Monitoring System
items.subtitle: Real-time monitoring & notification platform for drug stores
items.description: Web-based system that helps drug stores track antibiotic purchases in real time and pings them when something looks off — built as my Computer Engineering thesis with a 4-person team.
